old_system.name: 50% CGT Discount
old_system.description: 50% of the capital gain is tax-free for assets held more than 12 months.

new_system.name: CPI Indexation + 30% Floor
new_system.description: Cost base is adjusted for CPI inflation. Only real gains above inflation are taxed. A minimum 30% tax rate applies to net capital gains regardless of marginal rate.

hybrid_system.name: Hybrid Calculation
hybrid_system.description: For assets acquired before 1 July 2027: old 50% discount applies to gains accrued up to 30 June 2027. New CPI indexation applies to gains after that date.

pathways.label: Grandfathered — Pre-Budget or New Build
pathways.condition: Property owned before Budget Night (13 May 2026, 7:30 PM) OR any new build purchased at any time
pathways.treatment: Full upfront deductions against all income including salary. Rules unchanged.
pathways.example: You owned an investment property before budget night. Your $10,000 annual loss offsets your salary tax immediately.

pathways.label: Established Home — Post-Budget Purchase
pathways.condition: Established (existing) residential property purchased after 7:30 PM on 13 May 2026
pathways.treatment: Rental losses cannot offset salary income. Losses quarantined in a 'property bucket' — can only offset future property income or gains.
pathways.example: You buy an established investment property after Budget Night with a $10,000 annual loss. Your salary tax bill doesn't change. Loss sits quarantined.

pre_1985_assets.description: Assets purchased before 20 September 1985 historically had full CGT exemption.
pre_1985_assets.change: Exemption ends 1 July 2027. ATO will set new cost base via market valuation on that date.
pre_1985_assets.applies_to: All asset types including shares, property, and business assets

smsf.description: Self-Managed Super Funds retain existing one-third CGT discount. Not subject to new rules.
